description: Ground elevation (Copernicus DEM tiles) and geoid undulation (GeographicLib PGM grids). synthetic geoid grid: 36 x 19 samples at 10 deg, Offset -100, Scale 0.01, sample(row, col) = 1000 + 100*row + col, row 0 = 90N, col 0 = 0E. synthetic terrain tile: 5 x 5 at 0.25 deg, first sample 42.0N 44.0E, rows south, elevation = 400 + 10*row + col, sample (1,1) nodata, stored as (m + 500) / 0.2 in uint16 big-endian, 65535 nodata. A cell absent from the index is unknown (null), a 'sea' cell is 0 m.
